# serverroom_webhook (Resource)

A webhook endpoint: what happens on the account is POSTed to it, signed with its secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Everything that happens on the account, POSTed to your endpoint and signed.
resource "serverroom_webhook" "ops" {
  url         = "https://ops.example.com/hooks/servers"
  events      = ["*"]
  description = "ops alerts"
}

output "webhook_secret" {
  value     = serverroom_webhook.ops.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `events` (List of String) Event types, or ["*"] for all.
- `url` (String) The https:// endpoint.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean)
- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The signing secret, known only for an endpoint this configuration created.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import serverroom_webhook.ops wh_0123456789abcdef
```
